threat_event: Nation-state intrusion into network management planes exposes CPNI, network configurations, and customer networks across divisions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared local accounts and SBCs past support in the acquired regions; SYS-E1 persistent tunnels into the Carrier and customer networks; element logs not in the SIEM
existing_controls: 24x7 SOC; EDR on IT assets; TACACS+ with MFA in legacy regions; PAM for IT administrators
treatment_plan: Named AAA accounts with MFA in the acquired regions; replace or isolate unsupported SBCs; broker SYS-E1 access through group jump hosts; onboard element logs to the SIEM

threat_event: Shared service assurance platform exposes Carrier CPNI to affiliate operators and fails for three divisions at once
threat_source: Insider misuse through affiliate roles; platform failure
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One instance hosts the Carrier NOC, Engineering MNO, and Tower alarm tenants; legacy cross-tenant read role held by about 470 affiliate operators; DR never tested with all tenants; no intercompany CPNI agreement
existing_controls: Role-based access; quarterly certification; replication to provider B
treatment_plan: Remove the legacy role by 2026-11-30; tenant partitioning and minimum-data work package view; intercompany CPNI and tenant agreements; three-tenant failover test

threat_event: Ransomware spreads through shared services and halts OSS/BSS, ERP, and division systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared identity and cloud platform connect all divisions; regional NOC servers in the acquired regions lack offline configuration backups
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-G1; SYS-G3; SYS-C1; SYS-C2; SYS-E2; SYS-T3
existing_controls: Immutable backups in provider B; quarterly restore tests; EDR; PAM
treatment_plan: Offline configuration backups in every region; three-tenant failover test; cross-division ransomware tabletop

threat_event: A cross-division incident misses one or more regulator, customer, or investor notice deadlines
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Matrix never exercised; CPNI customer-notice hold must be reconciled with state law, SEC timing, FAA reports, CALEA reports, and Engineering's 24-hour customer notices
existing_controls: Group IR plan; disclosure committee charter; NOC Part 4 procedures
treatment_plan: Adopt the P08 matrix; cross-division tabletop by 2026-12-15; quarterly matrix review by the Group General Counsel

threat_event: AI used in customer-facing or consequential decisions without adequate governance
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Chatbot account recovery launched without CPNI review; deposit model adverse action notices missing for online orders; AI standard adopted after use cases went live
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-C10; deposit model; SYS-E1 triage; SYS-T2 inspection imagery
existing_controls: Group AI Standard (2026); Group AI council
treatment_plan: Group AI program conditions (P10): change gate, pre-launch CPNI review, adverse action notices for all channels, quarterly High-tier reporting

threat_event: Lawful-intercept system compromised or an intercept activated without lawful authorization
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Management path for SYS-C8 in the acquired regions shares SYS-C5 segments; SSI policies for 2 operating companies out of date
existing_controls: 14 named authorized employees; separate rooms; intercept records under 1.20004
treatment_plan: Isolated management path for SYS-C8 in the acquired regions; refile SSI policies; compromise reporting in P08
owner: Carrier Vice President, Network Security and Lawful Intercept

threat_event: Covered or counterfeit network equipment enters group or customer networks through procurement
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Covered equipment screening is a manual requisition check with no record; Carrier's 1.50007 certification relies on it
treatment_plan: Automated screening against the FCC Covered List and supplier attestations; record each result; FAR 52.204-25 reporting steps in P08

threat_event: Group identity platform compromised through token theft or help desk social engineering
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One identity platform for 45,000 workforce users and 2,100 outsourced agents
existing_controls: Phishing-resistant MFA for administrators; number matching for all users; help desk callback verification
treatment_plan: Phishing-resistant authenticators for all remote workforce by 2027-06-30; token binding for the BSS

threat_event: Intrusions go undetected in device fleets outside SIEM coverage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Acquired-region element logs, SYS-E1 gateway logs, RMU and smart lock logs are not in the SIEM
treatment_plan: Onboard the missing sources with use cases for management plane logins and RMU configuration changes

threat_event: Division controls assumed but not operating because of policy drift and undocumented inheritance
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Tower standards last aligned 2023; Tower inheritance not documented
existing_controls: Group policy set; annual attestation (Carrier, Engineering)
treatment_plan: Re-issue the Tower supplement; document inheritance; annual attestation
owner: Tower division security and compliance lead

threat_event: Major hurricane causes a multi-day regional outage across all three divisions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Florida concentration; shared crews; generator fuel logistics; RMU backhaul
existing_controls: Generators with 72 hours of fuel; DIRS procedures; mutual aid
treatment_plan: Joint storm plan across divisions; fuel contracts; lighting fallback procedure

threat_event: CPNI released to pretexters or sold by insiders through contact centers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 8,900 agents including 2,100 outsourced; CPNI training incomplete for vendors
existing_controls: Password-based telephone authentication; agent analytics in the SIEM
treatment_plan: Complete vendor CPNI training; extend analytics to vendor agents; quarterly call sampling

threat_event: A SaaS provider breach exposes customer or landowner data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: CCaaS, chatbot vendor, lease management SaaS, and bill print vendor hold sensitive data
treatment_plan: 24-hour incident notice in every contract; continuous monitoring of tier 1 vendors

threat_event: Materiality determination is delayed or the Item 106 disclosure misdescribes the program
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Disclosure committee has not rehearsed a cyber materiality decision
existing_controls: Disclosure committee charter covers cyber incidents
treatment_plan: Include a materiality decision in the 2026 tabletop

threat_event: Cloud misconfiguration exposes BSS or CDR data publicly
treatment_plan: Quarterly guardrail review; public exposure scans

threat_event: Regulatory certifications and filings are inaccurate because control gaps are not visible to signers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: CPNI certification statements, CALEA filings, and the 1.50007 certification rely on manual evidence
treatment_plan: Evidence-based certification pack fed by P07 results
owner: Carrier Senior Vice President, Regulatory and Compliance
